prompt.initial: First, use the stove's own control knob to turn on the burner under the pot. The toaster oven already contains food and its door must remain closed. Next, start the toaster oven by turning its own timer knob and inspect one of the two drawers, in either order; inspect a drawer by opening it, looking inside, and closing it. After the toaster oven has been started and one drawer has been inspected, complete the three remaining steps in any order: turn off the burner with the same stove knob, stop the toaster oven by returning the same timer knob to zero, and inspect the other drawer. When the burner and toaster oven are off and both drawers have been inspected and closed, press either green completion button.
